blocks.text: This page tracks the Pitt Meadows MLS® Home Price Index benchmark for October 2026: $832,600 for a typical home, down 4.0% over twelve months.
Pitt Meadows benchmark prices and trends, October 2026

A typical Pitt Meadows home carried an MLS® Home Price Index benchmark of $832,600 in October 2026. That is down 1.9% on the month, down 2.9% over three months, down 3.3% over six months and down 4.0% over the year. Over three years it is down 7.4%, and over five years little changed at +0.1%.
The weakest one-year move in Pitt Meadows was for an apartment homes at −8.0%; the strongest was a detached home at −1.3%.
The gap between a detached home ($1,172,600) and an apartment ($523,500) is $649,100, and a townhouse ($731,800) sits $208,300 above the apartment benchmark.
Against Greater Vancouver, where the all-home benchmark was $1,068,600, Pitt Meadows is 22.1% below. Over the year Greater Vancouver moved down 5.2% against down 4.0% here.
Of the 20 areas this board reports, Pitt Meadows ranks 18 by all-home benchmark, with Port Coquitlam above it at $840,200 and Sunshine Coast below it at $801,700.

Detached homes in Pitt Meadows: benchmark $1,172,600, little changed at −0.5% in a month, down 3.1% in three months, down 3.8% in six months, little changed at −1.3% in a year, down 8.8% in three years and down 6.2% in five. That is 33.9% below the detached benchmark for Greater Vancouver ($1,775,200).

Townhouse homes in Pitt Meadows: benchmark $731,800, little changed at −0.8% in a month, down 3.5% in three months, down 6.1% in six months, down 7.8% in a year, down 10.3% in three years and little changed at +0.8% in five. That is 27.3% below the townhouse benchmark for Greater Vancouver ($1,006,500).

Apartment homes in Pitt Meadows: benchmark $523,500, down 6.2% in a month, down 4.0% in three months, down 4.1% in six months, down 8.0% in a year, down 13.2% in three years and little changed at −1.3% in five. That is 22.3% below the apartment benchmark for Greater Vancouver ($673,400).

blocks.text: In dollars, the typical Pitt Meadows home is worth about $34,700 less than in October 2025, when the benchmark was near $867,300. By type, detached homes lost about $15,400, from $1,188,000 to $1,172,600, townhouses lost about $61,900, from $793,700 to $731,800, and apartments lost about $45,500, from $569,000 to $523,500 over those twelve months. Further back, the benchmark was near $861,000 six months ago and near $899,100 three years ago, so today's figure sits about $28,400 below the six-month mark and about $66,500 below the three-year mark. Against Greater Vancouver, the Pitt Meadows benchmark is about $236,000 below the regional $1,068,600; a year earlier the difference was about $259,900 below.
Pitt Meadows sales at a glance, past 12 months

Over the past year, 92 Pitt Meadows houses sold at a median of $1.23M (middle half $1.09M to $1.39M), half of them within 17 days. 65 condos sold at a median of $549,000 (middle half $485,000 to $603,000), half within 31 days. Quarter by quarter, the median house price eased from $1.28M to $1.18M between November–January and August–October (15 and 20 sales).

blocks.text: What the Pitt Meadows figure is
The $832,600 Pitt Meadows figure is a modelled price for a typical home, not a median, and it comes from Greater Vancouver REALTORS® for October 2026.

faq.q: What is the benchmark price of a home in Pitt Meadows?
faq.a: In October 2026, a typical Pitt Meadows home was $832,600, with detached at $1,172,600.

faq.q: Are Pitt Meadows home prices rising or falling?
faq.a: Pitt Meadows is down 4.0% over twelve months and down 2.9% over three months.
